messages.subject: Unable to run multivariate no linear models
parts:
I'm trying to fit a non-linear curve using BRMS. The code works absolutely fine when I use a single dependent variable , but it throws the following error :
Error : is.btl(btl) is not TRUE

Can anyone please help me out? New to this package, so still trying to figure my way around. 

Appreciate your help!

fit1 <- brm(
            bf(
               cbind(Awareness_LN) ~ 
                 alpha + 
                 (exp(betadirectbuy * (direct_buy/1)^powerdirectbuy) - 1) / (1 -adsdirectbuy) + 
                 (exp(betafb * (fb/1)^powerfb) - 1) / (1 -adsfb) +
                 (exp(betagdn * (gdn/1)^powergdn) - 1) / (1 -adsgdn) + 
                 (exp(betalkdin * (lkdin/1)^powerlkdin) - 1) / (1 -adslkdin) + 
                 (exp(betamob * (mob/1)^powermob) - 1) / (1 -adsmob) +
                 (exp(betabing * (bing/1)^powerbing) - 1) / (1 -adsbing) +
                 (exp(betabrok * (brok/1)^powerbrok) - 1) / (1 -adsbrok) +
                 (exp(betagoogle * (google/1)^powergoogle) - 1) / (1 -adsgoogle) +
                 (exp(betasearch * (search/1)^powersearch) - 1) / (1 -adssearch) +
                 (exp(betadisp * (disp/1)^powerdisp) - 1) / (1 -adsdisp) +
                 (exp(betaolv * (olv/1)^powerolv) - 1) / (1 -adsolv) +
                 (exp(betatw * (tw/1)^powertw) - 1) / (1 -adstw), 
               alpha + 
                 betadirectbuy + powerdirectbuy + adsdirectbuy + 
                 betafb + powerfb + adsfb + 
                 betagdn + powergdn + adsgdn + 
                 betalkdin + powerlkdin + adslkdin +
                 betamob + powermob + adsmob +
                 betabing + powerbing + adsbing +
                 betabrok + powerbrok + adsbrok +
                 betagoogle + powergoogle + adsgoogle +
                 betasearch + powersearch + adssearch +
                 betadisp + powerdisp + adsdisp +
                 betaolv + powerolv + adsolv +
                 betatw + powertw + adstw ~ 1 , 
               nl = TRUE
               ),
            data = Modelfile_final, 
            prior = list_of_priors,
            control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
            chains = 5,
            warmup = 1000,
            iter = 3000
            )
